title: Heart
description: A hollow, inflated heart balloon, drawn from the tip upward.

title: Ring
description: A diamond ring: band, prongs, then the faceted stone filling in.

title: Bottle
description: A longneck beer bottle: heel, body, shoulder and neck rise, then the crown cap closes it.

title: Wine glass
description: A tulip wine glass: foot and stem first, then the hollow bowl fills up.

title: Queen
description: A chess queen: stepped base, waisted body and a crown of points.

title: Teapot
description: A teapot with a curved spout, a loop handle and a domed lid with a knob.

title: Hourglass
description: An hourglass: pinched glass bulbs on two plates, three posts and a mound of sand.

title: Light bulb
description: A light bulb: glass globe, threaded screw base and a looping filament.
